title: 1 Corinthians Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on 1 Corinthians 13: sounding brass without love, what love does and does not do, seeing dimly in a mirror, and the greatest of the three.

questions.text: According to verse 1, what has a man become who speaks with the languages of men and of angels but does not have love?
questions.explanation: The verse says he has become sounding brass, or a clanging cymbal.

answers.text: A foreigner to those who hear him
Sounding brass, or a clanging cymbal

questions.text: What does verse 2 say a man is who has prophecy, all knowledge and all faith, but not love?
questions.explanation: The verse says that without love, he is nothing.

questions.text: What does verse 3 say about giving away all one's goods without love?
questions.explanation: The verse says that if he gives away all his goods to feed the poor, and gives his body to be burned, but does not have love, it profits him nothing.

questions.text: Which two things does verse 4 say love is?
questions.explanation: The verse says love is patient and is kind.

questions.text: What does verse 5 say love does not seek?
questions.explanation: The verse says love does not seek its own way, and is not provoked.

questions.text: What does verse 6 say love rejoices with?
questions.explanation: The verse says love does not rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth.

questions.text: Which four things does verse 7 say love does with all things?
questions.explanation: The verse says love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

answers.text: Bears, believes, hopes and endures them
Knows, tests, keeps and guards them
Sees, hears, speaks and judges them
Gives, takes, holds and leaves them

questions.text: According to verse 8, what will happen where there are various languages?
questions.explanation: The verse says that where there are various languages, they will cease.

questions.text: How does verse 12 say we see now?
questions.explanation: The verse says that now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face.

questions.text: Which is the greatest of faith, hope and love, according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: The verse says that faith, hope and love remain, and the greatest of these is love.
